info.name: Get latest driving score for a driver

params.name: driverContactId
params.description: Contact id to get driving score for

items.docs:
This is a BETA feature, under development and may change.
Reduction types are "HarshAcceleration", "HarshBrake", "HarshTurn", "Idling" or "Speeding".
Returns latest driving score with points lost, weaknesses and strengths
